author: Karl Rock
description:
A Pakistani taxi driver told me how an argument over a passenger's payment turned into an angry confrontation with her boyfriend!

While driving through Karachi, he explained that a woman had trouble paying for her ride. After he dropped her off, her boyfriend called him and allegedly started shouting and swearing before even hearing the driver's side of the story.

The driver says he tried to explain what happened, but eventually lost his temper and swore back. The payment finally arrived about an hour later.

Was the driver justified in losing his temper, or should he have stayed calm?
title: When Taxi Passengers Get Angry!

author: Karl Rock
description:
It's not just passengers who get scammed by taxi drivers in Pakistan. Sometimes the drivers are the victims!

During a taxi ride through Karachi, my driver explained how passengers have tricked him with payment confirmation screenshots. He claims it's happened six or seven times, with customers showing proof of a bank transfer that never actually arrived.

Now he refuses to accept screenshots as proof of payment until the money reaches his account.

Have you ever experienced this scam?
title: How Taxi Drivers Get Scammed!
